title: Dxcufgb's screen effects
description: Animated full-screen effects on a player's own screen while their character suffers a condition: every D&D 5e and 2024 condition (blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion by level, frightened, grappled, incapacitated, invisible, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned, unconscious/dying/dead) plus low HP. Made for a top-down map.
